Answer: B
Reason: The serial chest X-rays (Figures 1a, 3a, 4a, 6a) demonstrate a clear progression from initial nodular densities in the middle and lower lung fields to extensive, diffuse bilateral infiltrative disease with areas of radiolucency over time, consistent with the aggressive spread of bronchioloalveolar carcinoma. Options suggesting stability, regression, or isolated upper lobe involvement are contradicted by the visible worsening and distribution of opacities across the images.
